name: advance_state_machine_step
description: Advances a multi-state controller by one step. It branches on a state byte, and in the advance branch it copies two table words into the transfer registers, sets a 512-word block size (or an alternative when a flag bit is set), and then recurses into the next step.

name: configure_transfer_and_advance
description: Loads two words from data tables into the transfer registers, increments the state byte, sets a 512-word block size or an alternative, and computes the transfer address before calling the next step. It mirrors the state-advance branch of the controller step routine.

name: update_index_and_dispatch
description: Ends the current phase when an index equals 5. Otherwise it compares a position value with a table entry and, while still below it, saves the index (using 14 in place of zero) and calls the next routine. At index 4 it first sets a default count of 1200 if none is set.

name: stub_forward_to_routine
description: A three-instruction stub that copies a variable onto itself and then calls one other routine. It decodes from a gap between routines, so it does no work of its own beyond forwarding control.

name: forward_to_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns. The copy of a variable onto itself is a no-op, so the routine only forwards control.

name: rewrite_flag_if_set
description: Returns immediately unless a flag byte equals one. When it does, the byte is rewritten to one through a redundant clear-and-set sequence, so the net effect is that the flag stays set.

name: search_table_and_dispatch
description: Sets a flag and a counter of 22, then scans a table of 14-byte records from the end toward the start for a matching value. On a match it loads the next index and two words from lookup tables and calls three routines to apply them.

name: run_steps_then_wait_blitter
description: Calls an unnamed routine four times in a loop and then once more. One of the callees polls the blitter-busy bit until the blitter has finished its current operation.

name: configure_transfer_and_start
description: Writes two fixed address words into the transfer registers and sets a shared register to 14 and a mode value to 1. It then calls a routine to start the transfer.

name: advance_state_machine_with_counter
description: Runs one step of a state controller. It returns early while a counter or mode check is pending, otherwise it advances the state, loads transfer parameters from a table, sets a 512-word block size or an alternative, and recurses into the next phase. It is the same controller as the first routine with different data offsets.

name: forward_to_routine
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, passing control through with no other work.

name: configure_alternate_transfer_and_advance
description: Loads transfer words from a second pair of data tables, increments the state byte, sets a 512-word block size or an alternative, and calls the next routine. It is a variant of the transfer-and-advance routine that reads different table offsets.

name: scan_records_and_dispatch
description: Scans a table of 16-byte records and, for each record whose type bytes are not in the excluded set, calls a handler and reads the next field from a list of pointers. It repeats while a mode byte stays in range, then restores the saved mode byte and clears it before returning.

name: merge_nibble_into_register
description: Copies the high nibble of a state byte into the upper bits of a target byte at a fixed offset from an address register while keeping the low bits. When the low nibble equals 12 it also sets bit 3 of that target byte.

name: scan_records_dispatch_variant
description: Scans the same 16-byte record table as the main dispatcher, but its mode-2 branch does not reset the counter and its exit condition differs. It otherwise calls handlers and walks the pointer list in the same way.

name: merge_nibble_and_reset_state
description: Copies the high nibble of a state byte into the upper bits of a target byte at a fixed offset while keeping the low bits. When the low nibble equals 12 it sets bit 3 of the target byte and clears the state byte.

name: update_index_and_dispatch_alt
description: Performs the same index check as the sibling routine using the second index channel and a second position table. It ends the phase when the index equals 5 and otherwise saves the index and calls the next routine, using 14 in place of zero.

name: forward_to_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other work. The copy of a variable onto itself is a no-op.

name: stub_forward_to_routine
description: A three-instruction stub that copies a variable onto itself and then calls one other routine. It decodes from a gap between routines and does no work beyond forwarding control.

name: search_table_and_dispatch_alt
description: Sets a flag and a counter of 10, then scans a table of 14-byte records from the end toward the start for a matching value. On a match it loads the next index and two words from lookup tables and calls three routines to apply them.

name: repeat_call_four_times
description: Calls one routine four times in a loop and then once more, with no other work. It is the same loop shape as the routine that waits on the blitter, but without that wait.

name: configure_transfer_and_launch
description: Writes two fixed address words into the transfer registers, sets a shared register to 14 and a mode value to 1, then calls a routine to start the transfer. It performs the same setup as the sibling routine without its leading self-update.

name: forward_to_routine
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, passing control through with no other work.

name: forward_to_routine
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, passing control through with no other work.

description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, passing control through with no other work.

name: decrement_countdown_byte
description: Decrements a countdown byte and returns. The reload to 10 and the follow-on call sit behind a compound test that cannot succeed as written, so in effect only the decrement takes place.

name: forward_to_routine
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, passing control through with no other work.

name: decrement_countdown_byte_alt
description: Decrements a countdown byte and returns. Its reload and follow-on call sit behind the same impossible compound test as the sibling routine, so in effect it only decrements the byte.

name: forward_to_routine
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, passing control through with no other work.

name: decrement_four_digit_counter
description: Runs only while a guard flag is clear. It decrements the lowest ASCII digit with borrow into the higher digits, resets the digits to zero on underflow, and then redraws the four digits by calling a routine once per digit before clearing the flag.

name: decrement_counter_and_render_digits
description: Decrements an ASCII digit counter with borrow and resets it to zero on underflow. For each digit it computes a source address from the digit value times 40 plus a fixed base and passes it with a plane count of 1 to a draw routine.

name: set_flag_when_threshold_met
description: Sets a flag to one when its low bit is clear, a compared byte equals an ASCII zero, and a counter byte is below 50. Otherwise it leaves the flag unchanged.

name: set_flag_on_second_counter
description: Sets a flag to one when its low bit is clear, a compared byte equals an ASCII zero, and a second counter byte is below 50. Otherwise it leaves the flag unchanged.

name: decrement_digit_chain_and_draw
description: Runs only while a guard is clear. It decrements a units digit that borrows through a chain of ASCII digits, resets the chain to zeros on underflow, and redraws each changed digit by calling a routine. It clears the guard at the end.

name: redraw_fixed_position_fields
description: Calls a draw routine six times with constant screen coordinates and plane values to redraw six fixed-position fields. It then clears a flag.

name: compute_digit_glyph_address
description: Converts an ASCII digit to a glyph address by subtracting the ASCII zero, multiplying by 40 and adding a fixed base. It passes that address with a plane count of 1 to a draw routine.

name: copy_entries_and_decrement_counter
description: Copies two words from indexed tables into buffer locations, then runs the guarded digit-counter step when its guard is clear. That step decrements a digit chain with borrow, draws changed digits through glyph addresses, and clears the guard.

name: copy_entries_and_decrement_counter
description: Behaves the same as its sibling: it copies two indexed table words into buffer locations, then runs the guarded digit-counter decrement that draws changed digits and clears the guard.

name: copy_entries_and_decrement_counter
description: Repeats the same logic as the sibling routines: two indexed table words are copied into buffer locations, followed by the guarded digit-counter decrement with glyph drawing and guard reset.

name: copy_entries_and_decrement_counter
description: Copies two indexed table words into buffer locations, then runs the guarded digit-counter step. That step decrements a digit chain with borrow, draws changed digits through glyph addresses, and clears the guard.

name: copy_entries_and_decrement_counter
description: Copies two indexed table words into buffer locations, then runs the guarded digit-counter decrement with borrow and glyph drawing, and clears the guard afterwards.

name: copy_entry_and_decrement_counter
description: Copies one indexed table word into a buffer location, then runs the guarded digit-counter decrement with borrow, glyph drawing and guard reset.

name: decrement_counter_and_render_digits
description: Returns early while a guard is set. Otherwise it decrements a digit chain with borrow, resets the chain to zeros on underflow, and draws each digit by computing a glyph address from its value times 40 plus a fixed base.

name: decrement_counter_and_render_digits
description: Returns early while a guard is set. Otherwise it decrements a digit chain with borrow, resets the chain to zeros on underflow, and draws each digit through a glyph address computed from its value.

name: decrement_counter_and_render_digits
description: Returns early while a guard is set. Otherwise it decrements a digit chain with borrow and redraws each digit from a glyph address, resetting the chain to zeros on underflow.

name: decrement_counter_and_render_digits
description: Returns early while a guard is set. Otherwise it decrements a digit chain with borrow, resets it on underflow, and redraws the digits through glyph addresses derived from their values.

name: decrement_counter_and_render_digits
description: Returns early while a guard is set. Otherwise it decrements a digit chain with borrow, resets it on underflow, and redraws each digit through a glyph address derived from its value.

name: decrement_counter_and_render_digits
description: Returns while a guard is set. Otherwise it decrements a digit chain with borrow, resets it on underflow, and redraws each digit through a glyph address derived from its value, then clears the guard.

name: decrement_counter_and_render_digits
description: Returns while its guard is set. Otherwise it decrements a digit chain with borrow, resets it on underflow, and redraws the digits through glyph addresses derived from their values.

name: decrement_counter_and_render_digits
description: Returns while its guard is set. Otherwise it decrements a digit chain with borrow, resets it on underflow, and redraws the digits through glyph addresses, then clears the guard.

name: decrement_digit_chain_and_render
description: Decrements a digit chain with borrow, resets it on underflow, and redraws each digit through a glyph address derived from its value. It has no guard, so it runs on every call.

name: render_six_digit_glyphs
description: Redraws six digit positions by converting each digit to a glyph address, computed as its value times 40 plus a fixed base, and passing it with fixed coordinates to a draw routine. It clears a flag at the end.

name: stub_infinite_idle_loop
description: Spins in an infinite loop with no body, so control never returns to the caller. The code is a stub with no other work.

name: draw_eight_table_entries
description: Walks eight four-word entries from a fixed global table. For each entry it passes the first two words to a routine as two parameters.

name: draw_eight_table_entries
description: Repeats the same table walk: eight four-word entries from a fixed global table, with the first two words of each passed to a routine.

name: compute_record_address_and_start
description: Computes a record address from an index register using 56-byte records from a fixed base. It passes that address with a mode value of 7 and a count of 1 to a routine that starts the transfer.

name: clear_eight_table_words
description: Clears eight words of a global table, starting four bytes in and stepping eight bytes per word.

name: clear_eight_table_words
description: Clears eight words of a global table, starting four bytes in and stepping eight bytes per word. It repeats the same logic as its sibling routine.

name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores the values 4 and 3 into two adjacent parameter words and then calls a routine that uses them.

name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores the values 2 and 1 into two adjacent parameter words and then calls a routine that uses them.

name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores the values 3 and 4 into two adjacent parameter words and then calls a routine that uses them.

name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores the values 1 and 2 into two adjacent parameter words and then calls a routine that uses them.

name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores the values 6 and 5 into two adjacent parameter words and then calls a routine that uses them.

name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores the values 5 and 6 into two adjacent parameter words and then calls a routine that uses them.

name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores the values 4 and 3 into two adjacent parameter words and then calls a routine that uses them.

name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores the values 2 and 1 into two adjacent parameter words and then calls a routine that uses them.

name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores the values 3 and 4 into two adjacent parameter words and then calls a routine that uses them.

name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores the values 1 and 2 into two adjacent parameter words and then calls a routine that uses them.

name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores the values 6 and 5 into two adjacent parameter words and then calls a routine that uses them.

name: store_pair_and_call_routine
description: Stores the values 5 and 6 into two adjacent parameter words and then calls a routine that uses them.

name: call_two_routines_in_turn
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

name: call_two_routines_in_turn
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

name: shift_slot_table_with_insert
description: Compares the last slot of an eight-entry table with a reference word. If they differ, it shifts the entries one slot toward the front and stores the new value in the last slot. If they match, it shifts the entries toward the end and clears the first slot.

name: decrement_countdown_and_fill
description: Decrements a countdown word. When it reaches zero it sets a flag to one and fills eight consecutive entries with the value 7 in both halves, then returns the countdown value.

name: decrement_countdown_and_fill
description: Decrements a countdown word. When it reaches zero it sets a flag to one and fills eight consecutive entries with the value 7 in both halves.

name: fill_eight_entries_with_pair
description: Fills eight consecutive four-byte entries from a fixed global address with the value 7 in both halves of each entry.

name: decrement_timer_and_trigger
description: Returns if a timer word is zero. Otherwise it decrements a byte counter, and when the counter reaches zero it reloads it with 36 and calls a routine. The first test is always true, so the routine runs whenever the timer word is nonzero.

name: decrement_and_reload_on_zero
description: Acts only when a flag byte equals one. It then decrements a counter byte, and when the counter reaches zero it reloads it with 60 and calls a routine.

name: decrement_and_reload_on_zero
description: Decrements a counter byte unconditionally. When the counter reaches zero it reloads it with 60 and calls a routine.

name: reload_counter_and_call
description: Sets a counter byte to 60 and calls a routine. The comparison that follows is always true, so the call always runs.

name: start_sequence_on_countdown_zero
description: When a flag byte equals one it decrements the byte, and when the byte reaches zero it sets the byte to 4. It then writes 299 and 9 into two parameter words and calls a routine that starts the next step.

name: start_alternating_step_on_countdown
description: When a flag byte equals one it decrements the byte to zero and sets the state byte to 4. It adds a fixed base to a parameter chosen by the state's low bit, sets the mode to 6 with a count of 1, and calls a routine that starts the step.

name: compute_offset_and_start_step
description: Adds a fixed base to the index passed in a data register and stores the result as a parameter. It then sets the mode to 6 with a count of 1 and calls a routine that starts the step.

name: initialize_hardware_and_run_loop
description: Stores display and copper-list addresses, clears a 16-word block, and writes the palette color registers. It updates the interrupt enable register, copies a 3072-byte block, and then runs a frame loop that calls about forty routines and busy-waits between them.

name: select_mode_from_state_loop
description: Loops while a state test holds, choosing a mode value of 1, 2, 4 or 8 from a state byte and calling routines to advance it. After the loop it copies a 3072-byte block and calls routines that redraw the screen with fixed addresses.

name: poll_routine_with_delays
description: Sets a flag, then repeatedly runs a busy-wait of 10000 iterations and calls a routine until that routine reports completion. It polls the routine again until it returns false, repeats the delay and poll, and clears the flag.

name: toggle_state_byte_once
description: Calls a routine. If its result is true it clears a state word. Otherwise it returns early when the state word is already nonzero, and when it is zero it sets the word to one and flips a toggle byte between zero and one.

name: update_state_words_by_mode
description: Acts only in states 4 to 7 and only while a flag is clear. It calls a routine and stores the returned pair in one pair of words for states 5 and 6, and in another pair for states 4 and 7.

name: dispatch_on_state_value
description: Dispatches on a state byte. State 1 calls two routines, states 2 and 4 call a routine and store its result when the flag is clear, and states 3 and 5 call a routine and store a result pair when the flag is clear.

name: call_and_store_result_pair
description: If a flag is clear, calls a routine and stores its return value and the second returned word into two words.

name: call_and_store_result_pair
description: If a flag is clear, calls a routine and stores its return value and the second returned word into two other words.

name: encode_nonzero_lane_code
description: Returns a small code that reports which of four byte lanes in the input word is nonzero: 2 for the lowest, 1 for the next, 8 for the third and 4 for the highest. The low bit of the result reflects whether a second input word is nonzero.

name: select_mode_from_state_loop
description: Repeats the same frame loop as its sibling routine: it loops while a test holds, selects a mode value from a state byte, copies a 3072-byte block, and calls routines that redraw the screen. It is a gap-decoded copy with no separate behaviour.

name: call_and_branch_on_timing
description: When a flag is set it calls four routines. It compares a timing word offset by 101 with a limit, and whether the comparison passes only decides whether it returns right after the four calls or falls through.

name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls another routine four times in succession and then returns. It performs no other operations on data.

name: clear_state_bytes_and_call
description: Writes zero into a block of sixteen state bytes, then calls two routines and returns.

name: save_state_call_and_restore
description: Copies four words between two register-addressed buffers, saves the state byte, clears it around a call to a routine, and restores the saved value afterward.

name: save_state_call_and_restore
description: Uses the same save, call and restore pattern as its sibling, copying two words instead of four.

name: call_with_saved_state
description: Saves the state byte, clears it around a call to a routine, and restores the saved value afterward. It takes one of two branches that differ only by the state value.

name: set_state_on_top_bits
description: Returns without change unless the state byte is zero. When its top four bits are all set, it sets the byte to one and calls a routine.

name: call_chain_by_counter_state
description: Returns unless the state byte differs from the ASCII letter n. It then calls a routine and calls a second routine depending on whether a counter word is zero and whether the state byte is minus one.

name: call_two_routines_in_turn
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

name: call_two_routines_in_turn
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

name: loop_table_bytes_and_call
description: Loops over twelve table bytes from index 11 down to 0. For each byte it stores eight times the byte and an index-offset value into two parameter words, then calls a routine.

name: advance_state_code_and_draw
description: Advances a state code through a fixed successor mapping, where some successors depend on bit 0 of a data byte. It computes a source address from the new code and a second index and passes it to a routine, using a separate destination and count when the original code was 6.

name: branch_on_counter_and_copy
description: Compares a counter with 54 and takes one of two paths. Each path clears a state byte, calls several routines, and copies a word pair into the slot after it before a final call; the two paths copy different slot pairs.

name: copy_slot_pair_and_call
description: Clears a state byte around several routine calls, copies two word pairs from fixed source slots into the slots after them, and then calls a final routine.

name: copy_alt_slot_pair_call
description: Uses the same pattern as its sibling routine, copying a different pair of slots around the routine calls and state-byte clear before the final call.

name: load_record_fields_by_state
description: Uses the state byte minus one, times 16, to select a 16-byte record from a fixed table. It copies the first two bytes into two parameter words, the third byte into the state byte, and the fourth byte into a shared word.

name: dispatch_calls_by_state_value
description: Dispatches on a state byte and returns early for the ASCII digit one or the letter q under a flag test. Otherwise it calls a routine a number of times that depends on the state value, with seven calls for state zero and a few calls for states two to seven.

name: dispatch_calls_by_state_value
description: Repeats the state dispatch of its sibling without the leading address setup, returning early under the same flag and character tests and calling a routine a state-dependent number of times.

name: pass_pointer_word_fixed_y
description: Reads a word through the address register and passes it with a fixed Y value of 58 and a count of 10 to a routine.

name: pass_offset_two_copy_pair
description: Reads the word at offset 2 of the address register and passes it with a fixed X value of 208 and a count of 12 to a routine. It then copies a shared word into two destination slots.

name: pass_word_at_offset_four
description: Reads the word at offset 4 of the address register and passes it with a fixed Y value of 34 and a count of 13 to a routine.

name: pass_offset_six_copy_pair
description: Reads the word at offset 6 of the address register and passes it with a fixed X value of 16 and a count of 13 to a routine. It then copies a shared word into two other destination slots.

name: pass_word_at_offset_eight
description: Reads the word at offset 8 of the address register and passes it with a fixed Y value of 34 and a count of 13 to a routine.

name: pass_word_at_offset_ten
description: Reads the word at offset 10 of the address register and passes it with a fixed Y value of 34 and a count of 0 to a routine.

name: pass_word_at_offset_fourteen
description: When a state byte is the letter n or nonzero, reads the word at offset 14 of the address register and passes it with a fixed Y value of 34 and a count of 10 to a routine.

name: adjust_counter_and_pass_word
description: Subtracts 80 from a counter word and calls a routine. It then passes the word at offset 14 with a Y value of 131 when a state byte is nonzero and 34 otherwise.

name: call_twice_with_offset_position
description: Adds 20 to a position word and subtracts 5 from a second parameter, then calls a routine twice, once with each of two base addresses.

name: adjust_counter_pass_word_alt
description: Subtracts 80 from a second counter word and calls a routine. It then passes the word at offset 14 with a Y value of 131 unless a state byte is nonzero, in which case it uses 34.

name: set_fixed_source_and_call
description: Sets a fixed source address, a mode value of 35 and a count of 2, then calls a routine.

name: transfer_row_when_nonzero
description: When a position word and a second word are both nonzero, it calls a routine and stores the position word in a saved slot. It then adjusts the second word by 97 when the state is below 55, computes a row address from an index of 720-byte rows plus a base, and calls a routine. The index gains 12 unless the state is the letter q.

name: transfer_row_when_nonzero
description: Repeats the conditional row transfer of its sibling without the leading index adjustment. It calls a routine, saves the position word, adjusts the second word, and calls a routine with a row address computed from the index.

name: call_two_routines_in_turn
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

name: call_two_routines_in_turn
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

name: check_value_threshold_and_call
description: Calls a routine and reads its result, then returns early when the result exceeds 18 for a type byte of 4 or exceeds 28 otherwise. Otherwise it reads a second result and calls a routine when that value is below 6.

name: run_three_way_step_sequence
description: Counts down a delay word and, when it reaches zero, copies pairs of parameter words. It then runs one of three branches chosen by a flag byte, calling routines with a marker value set and cleared around each call.

name: handle_state_four_and_reset
description: When the state byte is 4 and a flag byte is zero, it clears the flag, calls a routine chosen by a value of 1, 2 or other, and resets the state byte. Otherwise it returns early or clears the channel counters and sets the state to 4 with a timer of 15.

name: handle_state_four_and_reset
description: Same state-four handling as its sibling, clearing the other channel's counter and loading its timer with 15.

name: run_three_way_step_sequence
description: Same three-way sequence as its sibling for the second channel, using a delay word and parameter pairs from the second set of words.

name: dispatch_state_with_position_offsets
description: Dispatches on a state byte from 1 to 5, calling a set of routines for each state and adding fixed offsets of 40, 30 or 60 to a position word in some states. A state value of 9 is first normalized to 1.

name: dispatch_state_with_position_offsets
description: Same state dispatch as its sibling, using a second position word and a different number of routine calls for each state.

name: mask_state_nibble_and_call
description: Clears a state byte and calls a routine, then keeps only the low four bits of the state byte and calls two routines.

name: mask_state_nibble_and_call
description: Repeats its sibling routine: it clears the state byte, calls a routine, masks the state to its low four bits, and then calls two routines.

name: clear_state_and_call_sequence
description: Clears a state byte and calls a routine, clears the byte again, and then calls two more routines.

name: clear_state_and_call_sequence
description: Repeats its sibling routine: it clears a state byte, calls a routine, clears the byte again, and then calls two more routines.

name: call_state_zero_then_one
description: Calls a routine with the state byte set to zero, then sets the byte to one and calls the routine again.

name: call_state_zero_then_two
description: Calls a routine with the state byte set to zero, then sets the byte to two and calls the routine again.

name: call_state_zero_then_one
description: Calls a routine with the state byte set to zero, then sets the byte to one and calls the routine again.

name: call_state_zero_then_two
description: Calls a routine with the state byte set to zero, then sets the byte to two and calls the routine again.

name: stub_forward_to_routine
description: A five-instruction gap-decoded stub that calls one other routine and returns. It does no work beyond forwarding control.

name: clear_state_byte
description: Sets the state byte to zero and returns.

name: clear_state_byte
description: Sets the state byte to zero and returns.

name: update_movement_state_machine
description: Advances a movement state machine. It checks an active flag, reads a motion table to update two position words, and then either sets a direction bit and state code from the low bits of the state byte or branches on the state's bit fields to choose the next state. It calls routines for each update step.

name: call_routine_by_state
description: Calls one routine when the state byte equals one and a different routine otherwise, then returns.

name: compute_difference_magnitude
description: Subtracts one signed word from another and returns the result, with a negative difference converted to its magnitude minus one. The second returned word holds that magnitude when the difference was negative and zero otherwise.

name: update_channel_a_position
description: Runs one channel's update: it clears the channel state, counts down a delay word and returns while it is nonzero, then copies that channel's position words into working words and calls two routines to advance it.

name: update_channel_b_position
description: Channel B counterpart of its sibling routine, using its own delay word and position words, with the vertical offset adjusted by minus 100.

name: load_record_into_working_words
description: Uses the state byte minus one, times 16, to select a 16-byte record from a fixed table. It copies six words into working words, sets the state byte from the record's twelfth byte, and copies the last word into another working word.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately with no work. It is an empty stub called from several places.

name: dispatch_state_marker_and_position
description: Dispatches on a small state word. For states 2 and 3 it makes four routine calls per branch, and the state-two path writes a fixed marker of 79 into two addressed bytes, reads a table byte, adjusts a position word by 30 and a counter by 1, then calls routines.

name: dispatch_state_six_position_step
description: Calls two routines unless the state is 6. In state 6 it calls a routine, adds 40 to one of two position words chosen by a flag, and then calls another routine.

name: dispatch_state_seven_position_step
description: Same as its sibling for state 7: it calls two routines unless the state is 7, otherwise it calls a routine, adds 40 to one of two position words chosen by a flag, and makes a final call.

name: clear_addressed_bytes_around_call
description: Clears one addressed byte, calls a routine, copies a table byte into the state byte, calls another routine, and then clears a second addressed byte.

name: set_state_four_then_clear
description: Sets the state byte to 4 and then to zero, performing the same writes on both flag paths without calling any routine.

name: set_state_three_then_clear
description: Sets the state byte to 3 and then to zero, performing the same writes on both flag paths without calling any routine.

name: call_twice_then_conditional_call
description: Calls two routines, then calls a third routine when a flag word is zero.

name: set_interrupt_enable_bits
description: Calls a routine once when the state byte is zero, then writes a value with bit 15 set and another bit set to the interrupt enable and request registers. Bit 15 set means the write enables the listed interrupts.

name: copy_scaled_words_set_interrupts
description: When a bit-4 flag is clear, it copies sixteen words from a pointer, doubling each and masking it to 12 bits, then sets the state to 112 and calls three routines. When the flag is set, it writes interrupt control values to the enable and request registers.

name: map_state_to_code_value
description: Maps a state byte to one of a few fixed codes: 135 for states 5 or 9, 230 for states 6 or 10, 125 for state 1, 225 for state 0, and 120 for any other value.

name: set_state_code_to_225
description: Sets the state byte to 225 and returns.

name: set_state_code_to_125
description: Sets the state byte to 125 and returns.

name: set_state_code_to_220
description: Sets the state byte to 220 and returns.

name: set_state_code_to_135
description: Sets the state byte to 135 and returns.

name: set_state_code_to_230
description: Sets the state byte to 230 and returns.

name: copy_table_word_set_state
description: Calls a routine, copies a word selected by an index into a shared word, and reads the indexed table value into the state byte. It finally sets the state byte to 53.

name: forward_to_routine
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, passing control through with no other work.

name: forward_to_routine
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, passing control through with no other work.

name: countdown_reload_30_and_call
description: When a state byte equals one, it counts down a word and returns while the word is nonzero. When the word reaches zero it reloads it with 30 and calls a routine.

name: call_on_pair_change
description: When a state byte equals one and a stored pair of words differs from the current pair, it calls three routines and copies the current pair into the stored pair.

name: call_on_pair_change
description: Same as its sibling for a second pair of words: when the state is one and the pair differs from the stored pair, it calls three routines and updates the stored pair.

name: forward_to_routine
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, passing control through with no other work.

name: run_call_groups_with_resets
description: Makes routine calls in groups of two, three and three, clearing two counter words after each of the first three groups, then makes one final call.

name: run_call_groups_pointer_step
description: Makes routine calls in the same groups of two, three and three as its sibling, stepping a pointer word and setting a counter word to 22 between groups, then makes one final call.

name: run_call_groups_set_flag
description: Clears a state byte, makes routine calls in groups of three, three and one, and clears a counter word between the first two groups. It then sets the state byte to one.

name: run_call_groups_set_flag
description: Clears a state byte, makes routine calls in groups of three, three and one, and clears a counter word between the first two groups. It then sets the state byte to one.

name: run_call_groups_set_flag
description: Clears a state byte, makes routine calls in groups of three, three and one, and clears a counter word between the first two groups. It then sets the state byte to one.

name: run_stepped_call_groups
description: Clears a state byte and makes grouped routine calls, stepping a pointer word and setting a counter word to 22 between groups. It then sets the state byte to one.

name: run_stepped_call_groups
description: Repeats the grouped call sequence with pointer steps and counter resets of its sibling, then sets the state byte to one.

name: run_stepped_call_groups
description: Repeats the grouped call sequence with pointer steps and counter resets of its sibling, then sets the state byte to one.

name: compute_row_address_when_active
description: When a counter word is nonzero, it calls a routine and sets a mode value of 2 with a count of 24. It computes a row address from two index words times 384 plus a base, adjusts a position word by minus 13, and calls a routine.

name: compute_row_address_when_active
description: Same as its sibling routine, but computes the row address from a different base address.

name: offset_position_by_table_entry
description: Adds a pair of words from a table, selected by an index times four, to a position word pair.

name: update_channels_by_distance
description: Compares position words for two channels against distance thresholds. When a channel is close enough and its state qualifies, it toggles state bits with exclusive-OR masks, writes the updated bytes, and calls routines to advance the state, with separate paths for each channel.

name: set_flag_bit_two_store
description: Sets two counter words to 4 and 7, calls a routine, then ORs bit 1 into the state byte and stores it into an addressed byte.

name: set_flag_bit_zero_store
description: Sets two counter words to 4, calls a routine, then ORs bit 0 into the state byte and stores it into an addressed byte.

name: forward_to_routine
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, passing control through with no other work.

name: copy_word_pairs_to_globals
description: Copies four words from two source pairs into four destination words, pairing the first source word of each pair with one destination and the second source word with another, then returns.

name: handle_state_and_copy_pair
description: Sets a counter to 10. When the state byte is nonzero it clears the state, calls a routine, adds 100 to a position word, restores the state and calls again. Otherwise it copies one word pair into a second pair and makes four routine calls.

name: call_state_113_then_one
description: Sets the state byte to 113, calls a routine, then sets the state byte to one.
